scope: Theorem 7.1 (Criticality with a nilpotent quotient action) of the manuscript “No percolation at criticality on quasi-transitive graphs” (preprints/No-percolation-at-criticality-on-quasi-transitive-graphs-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 213 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5929ccea200fd743), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G be an infinite connected locally finite graph of subexponential growth. Suppose a group Λ acts by automorphisms on G with finitely many vertex orbits and admits an epimorphism ϱ : Λ → N onto a finitely generated nilpotent group, such that ker ϱ has finite vertex orbits and ϱ(Λv) is finite for every vertex v. Here Λv = {g ∈ Λ : gv = v} is the vertex stabilizer. If pc(G) < 1, then Ppc(G)(|Cv| = ∞) = 0 (v ∈ G). Consequently, critical percolation has almost surely no infinite cluster.
